# Arranging Fricasseed Chicken

## Ingredients

- 1 fricasseed chicken

## Instructions

1. Put the neck and ribs at the left end of the dish.
2. Place the backbone at the right end.
3. Put the breast over the ribs.
4. Arrange the wings on each side of the breast, with the second joints next to the side-bones.
5. Cross the ends of the drumsticks over the tail.
